tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. She sits on the edge of a turquoise pool, feet in the water, squeezing the butter-yellow tube onto the back of her hand, curls piled up, laughing. She wears a mustard linen camp shirt and white linen shorts. Hard midday sun, the water bright behind her. 50mm, framed from the thighs up.
